classifications.title: Cancel semantics
evidence: RRP-2 adds a Runtime-owned task.cancel JSON-RPC boundary with typed protocol params and result.

task.cancel requires caller authorization, concrete task/run identity, expected current status, expected task updated_at, bounded cancel_id, and a Runtime-computed cancel request fingerprint before terminal evidence.
Only Created, Queued, and Running tasks are cancellable; missing, stale, mismatched, completed, failed, malformed, ambiguous, or unrelated requests fail closed before TaskCancelled evidence.
Exact replay is idempotent only when the current durable TaskCancelled payload matches the same cancel request fingerprint; otherwise cancelled tasks fail closed without duplicate terminal evidence.
VSIX protocol validators and runtime client projections cover task.cancel params/results while remaining thin transport validation over Runtime authority.
classifications.next_action: Use task.cancel as the explicit Runtime-owned cancellation boundary while closing the remaining Runtime Release Readiness blockers.

classifications.title: Real process loss Recovery E2E
evidence: RRP-3 replaces create_new MCP approval claim lock authority with an OS-owned advisory file lock over a non-authoritative residual lock file.
RRP-3.1 retains the approval claim lock through executing evidence, actual tools/call, result normalization, and terminal approval append.

terminalize_mcp_tool_approval rereads latest matching approval state before appending terminal evidence and refuses missing, non-executing, or changed approval_state_fingerprint transitions, preventing outcome_unknown-to-consumed terminal chains.

recover_unfinished_mcp_tool_approvals uses a nonblocking attempt on the same execution-scoped lock, skips WouldBlock live owners without ledger mutation, rereads latest matching state under the lock, and appends outcome_unknown at most once only for latest executing evidence.

test:rrp3-process-loss launches actual brownie-runtime child processes with an isolated trusted active Mode Pack snapshot and deterministic fake MCP stdio server, verifies stale lock progress, executing-before-spawn recovery, concurrent recovery without duplicate outcome_unknown, recovery during live tools/call as a no-op, mid-tools/call process loss recovery, independent process racing with at most one tools/call, and terminal consumed non-rerun after restart.
The existing CI-invoked VSIX check path now invokes pnpm --workspace-root test:rrp3-process-loss.
classifications.next_action: Use RRP-3/RRP-3.1 process-loss and race-safety evidence as the local Runtime recovery baseline while closing the remaining Runtime Release Readiness blockers.

classifications.title: Durable schema version and migration
evidence: RRP-4 added .brownie/store-schema.json as the release-level durable store schema manifest for local Runtime state, with schema id, manifest format version, store schema version, minimum runtime schema version, current state, and bounded migration source only.
RRP-4.1 advances the local durable store schema from v1 to v2 and adds an explicit Runtime/store-owned migration registry with a v1 to v2 migration path.

RRP-4.1 persists a bounded migration_in_progress marker before migration work, writes the v2 store-layout.json marker through the synced atomic helper, and replaces the schema manifest with current v2 only after the marker validates.

First-touch recovery resumes interrupted v1 to v2 migration idempotently after real process-loss at the in-progress manifest write, the store-layout.json marker write, or the current v2 manifest write, while conflicting partial migration layout state fails closed before task mutation.
The v1 task/run/ledger fixture preserves task identity, run ledger order, headless checkpoint resume fingerprint, and task/run/checkpoint bytes across migration before post-migration resume mutation.

Manifest parsing is strict and validation fails closed for malformed JSON, unknown fields, wrong schema id, unsupported migration state, zero versions, future store schema versions, newer minimum runtime versions, missing current v2 layout markers, or conflicting partial migration state.

BrownieStore::from_env_or_cwd gates store-backed Runtime methods before durable JSON-RPC work proceeds, and task state, run ledger, headless continuation, run session, journey, objective admission, completion finalization, active ModePack, and ModePack candidate durable paths check schema before mutation through their read/write entrypoints. Store-free status remains outside the durable gate.

cargo test -p brownie-store durable_schema -- --test-threads=1 covers v2 manifest creation, missing-manifest adoption, v1 manifest migration, real process-loss migration resume at in-progress/layout/current-v2 checkpoints, v1 task/run/ledger fixture preservation, partial migration conflict rejection, malformed rejection, future-version rejection before mutation, and minimum-runtime-version rejection.

guard:durable-schema-migration checks that the v1 to v2 registry, migration_in_progress marker, store-layout.json marker, behavior test names, and reopened release blocker accounting remain present; it is a drift/deletion guard, while Rust tests provide behavior evidence.
classifications.next_action: Use the RRP-4.1 durable schema migration and interrupted recovery baseline while closing RRP-5.1 and then the CI release gate.

RRP-4.1 adds pnpm --workspace-root guard:durable-schema-migration to the existing VSIX check path and adds focused brownie-store real process-loss migration and v1 durable fixture preservation tests, but direct .github workflow wiring remains blocked by missing OAuth workflow scope.

RRP-5 adds guard:protocol-event-canonization to the existing CI-invoked VSIX check path, and RRP-5.1 extends that guard so CI-invoked checks require the Rust-generated semantic protocol contract, VSIX golden tests, unknown-field policy evidence, and durable event migration coupling.

RRP-5.3 extends guard:protocol-event-canonization so the CI-invoked checks require recursive JSON Schema type_schemas and method schema refs/fingerprints; RRP-5.4 further requires fixed ledger payload schema fingerprints, separate diagnostic instance-shape fingerprints, and write/read payload envelope validation evidence; RRP-5.5 requires per-event payload classification inventory and blocks release while any ledger payload remains versioned-open or typed-known-fields-open; RRP-5.6 additionally requires TaskCompleted known terminal evidence before append and in generated descriptors; RRP-5.7 moves the terminal task event family to strict typed payload schemas; RRP-5.8 moves PermissionChecked and PermissionDenied to strict typed permission decision payload schemas; RRP-5.9 moves selected tool planning, intent, execution request, execution permission, and execution denial payload schemas to strict typed contracts; RRP-5.10 moves MCP approval state plus tool completion/failure terminal payload schemas to strict typed contracts; RRP-5.11 moves Codebase Index and verification recovery context payload schemas to strict typed contracts; RRP-5.12 moves task/LLM lifecycle payload schemas to strict typed contracts; RRP-5.13 moves task admission, running-deadline/admission, mode-resolution, and external ModePack provenance-denial payload schemas to strict typed contracts; RRP-5.14 moves ToolPlanned, ToolIntentParsed, and ToolIntentRejected to strict typed tool planning/intent parsing contracts; RRP-5.15 moves subtask orchestration/dispatch contracts to strict typed while keeping remaining open families release-blocking.

RRP-7 adds guard:platform-deadline-durability to the existing CI-invoked VSIX check path and makes the Runtime release-readiness guard require that VSIX command.

RRP-7.2 extends guard:platform-deadline-durability so the CI-invoked VSIX check path requires Windows atomic replace and directory durability evidence, Windows stale process-lock recovery, Runtime-wide persisted deadline propagation with resume-time expiry, and MCP response-after-receive process-loss evidence.

classifications.title: Protocol/Event canonization
evidence: RRP-5 adds docs/architecture/runtime-protocol-event-canonical-map.json as the canonical Runtime-owned protocol/event ownership map for JSON-RPC method groups, generated compatibility families, event domains, durable ledger variants, CLI transport subset, VSIX validators/client calls, and docs anchors.

RRP-5.1 adds docs/architecture/runtime-semantic-protocol-contract.json generated by brownie-protocol::semantic_contract and checked by the brownie-protocol-semantic-contract binary for representative semantic request/result evidence.

RRP-5.2 expands that generated semantic contract to all 51 explicit Runtime methods in the canonical map, with request/result top-level field semantics, no-param policy, client surface metadata, all-public-param unknown-field evidence, and guard-enforced method set equality.

RRP-5.3 adds recursive Rust-derived JSON Schema documents for method param/result types through schemars, including nested $defs, method request/result schema refs, and recursive schema fingerprints so nested object/enum/array shape drift changes generated evidence.

RRP-5.4 separates ledger payload contract fingerprints from payload instance fingerprints and validates current v2 envelopes on append/read while accepting verified legacy v1 envelopes for compatibility.

RRP-5.5 adds an explicit LedgerPayloadSchemaClassification inventory for every LedgerEventKind and records that JSON-RPC request/result contracts plus schema/instance fingerprint split are closed, while full typed ledger payload schema coverage remains partial.

RRP-5.6 closes the TaskCompleted unknown-only payload gap by requiring at least one recognized bounded terminal evidence field before durable append and by making guard:protocol-event-canonization fail if generated descriptors omit known_field_required:true.

RRP-5.7 moves TaskCompleted, TaskFailed, and TaskCancelled to strict_typed terminal task payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed terminal evidence before new appends, preserves v1/v2 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 77 to 74.

RRP-5.8 moves PermissionChecked and PermissionDenied to strict_typed permission decision payload schemas, rejects additional fields, malformed allow/reason/mode/action evidence, preserves v1/v2/v3 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 74 to 72. RRP-5.9 moves ToolPermissionChecked, ToolPlanApproved, ToolPlanDenied, ToolIntentPermissionChecked, ToolIntentApproved, ToolIntentDenied, ToolExecutionRequested, ToolExecutionPermissionChecked, and ToolExecutionDenied to strict_typed selected tool payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing tool/action/request evidence, preserves v1/v2/v3/v4 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 72 to 63. RRP-5.10 moves McpToolExecutionApproved, ToolExecutionCompleted, and ToolExecutionFailed to strict_typed MCP approval/tool terminal payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing approval/terminal evidence, preserves v1/v2/v3/v4/v5 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 63 to 60. RRP-5.11 moves CodebaseIndexPermissionChecked, CodebaseIndexSnapshotBuilt, CodebaseIndexQueryCompleted, CodebaseIndexSelectionReadCompleted, CodebaseIndexPromptContextMaterialized, and VerificationRecoveryContextReadMaterialized to strict_typed Codebase Index/verification context payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing bounded context evidence, preserves v1 through v6 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 60 to 54. RRP-5.12 moves AgentLoopStarted, AgentLoopCompleted, TaskCompletionAccepted, PromptBuilt, PromptSensitiveScanCompleted, PromptSensitiveScanFailed, LlmRequestCreated, LlmRequestFailed, LlmResponseReceived, SecondPassPromptBuilt, SecondPassLlmRequestCreated, SecondPassLlmRequestFailed, and SecondPassLlmResponseReceived to strict_typed task/LLM lifecycle payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing bounded lifecycle evidence, preserves v1 through v7 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 54 to 41. RRP-5.13 moves TaskStarted, TaskRunning, ModeResolved, ExternalModePackChildProvenanceDenied, and ExternalModePackTaskProvenanceDenied to strict_typed task admission/mode-resolution payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing bounded admission/mode evidence, preserves v1 through v8 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 41 to 36. RRP-5.14 moves ToolPlanned, ToolIntentParsed, and ToolIntentRejected to strict_typed tool planning/intent parsing payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing tool_ids/parser/rejection evidence, preserves v1 through v9 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 36 to 33.

All other current LedgerEventKind payload families are classified as versioned_open release-blocking debt instead of an any fallback; guard:protocol-event-canonization fails if descriptors return to any{...}, if classifications are missing, or if full closure is claimed while open classifications remain.

The generated semantic contract records event_payload_schema_classifications, event_payload_schema_classification_count, release_blocking_open_payload_count, per-event payload_schema_contract_status, TaskCompleted terminal descriptor evidence, PermissionChecked/PermissionDenied permission_decision_payload descriptor evidence, selected tool descriptor evidence, MCP approval descriptor evidence, tool terminal descriptor evidence, Codebase Index descriptor evidence, verification context descriptor evidence, task/LLM lifecycle descriptor evidence, task admission/mode-resolution descriptor evidence, tool planning/intent parsing descriptor evidence, and subtask orchestration/dispatch descriptor evidence so the partial ledger-payload state is machine-auditable rather than hidden behind a closed claim.

The remaining 21 LedgerEventKind payload families stay versioned_open release-blocking debt until each is assigned a strict typed, payload_absent, or legacy_compatibility_only contract with validation evidence.

RRP-5.15 moves SubtaskOrchestrationQueued, SubtaskHandoffPrepared, SubtaskSchedulerReadinessRecorded, SubtaskDispatchPlanPrepared, SubtaskDispatchContractPrepared, SubtaskDispatchAdmissionEvaluated, SubtaskDispatchReadinessSnapshotRecorded, SubtaskDispatcherGuardVerdictRecorded, SubtaskDispatchDecisionRecorded, SubtaskDispatchCandidateManifestRecorded, SubtaskDispatchHandoffEnvelopeRecorded, and ParentJoinContinuationFingerprintConsumed to strict_typed subtask orchestration/dispatch payload schemas, rejects additional fields and malformed or missing bounded subtask/dispatch/candidate/handoff/parent-join evidence, preserves v1 through v10 payload-envelope read compatibility, and reduces release_blocking_open_payload_count from 33 to 21.
classifications.next_action: Assign strict typed, payload-absent, or legacy-compatibility schemas to every remaining 21 open payload LedgerEventKind before treating this blocker as closed.

RRP-6 physically moves the task.list handler and task-list transport-bound helpers from crates/brownie-runtime/src/lib.rs into crates/brownie-runtime/src/task_progress.rs, colocating task-list transport bounds with task progress overview and parent-join projection authority without changing JSON-RPC behavior.

scripts/guard-runtime-module-decomposition.mjs validates the assessment against live source metrics, lib.rs production/test ceilings, required boundary tokens, task_progress ownership, and non-authority rules; its tests fail closed for task.list drifting back into lib.rs, missing task_progress ownership, and metric tampering.

classifications.title: Platform, deadline, and durability hardening
evidence: RRP-7 adds docs/architecture/runtime-platform-deadline-durability-hardening.json as the finite local Runtime durability assessment and ensures TaskStore::write_task_state uses the shared synced atomic write helper.

TaskStore::write_task_state uses a sibling temporary file, create_new, file write, file sync, atomic replacement, and parent-directory sync; RunLedger::append_many fsyncs appended ledger evidence and syncs the run directory before terminal transition markers are removed.

RRP-7.1 introduces McpStdioDeadline so one process-local monotonic MCP stdio budget spans response wait and child-exit wait, and late-child-exit handling records bounded process-tree cleanup evidence.

Task terminal completion and cancellation paths acquire a per-run terminal-mutation lock, re-read current state inside the lock, require expected status plus updated_at freshness, and recover terminal state/ledger process-loss gaps through terminal-transition.json.

Deterministic durable write failpoints cover disk_full_before_write, truncated_state_before_rename, and rename_denied_after_sync, proving failure closes before committed state replacement, terminal ledger append, or temporary-file leakage.

RRP-7.2 rejects symlink and Windows reparse durable targets, uses Windows MoveFileExW write-through atomic replacement, implements Windows parent directory sync through FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS, and fails closed for unsupported non-Unix/non-Windows durable atomic replace or directory sync primitives.
RRP-7.2 implements Windows stale process-lock recovery with OpenProcess and zero-time WaitForSingleObject liveness checks before dead-owner lock files are atomically claimed and removed.

RRP-7.2 adds a RuntimeDeadline protocol field for task.run, persists the chosen deadline into TaskRecord during Running transition, rejects mismatched resume deadlines, and fails closed before resume mutation when the persisted wall-clock deadline has expired.

RRP-7.2 adds real child-process-loss evidence for the MCP response-after-receive window by aborting after durable MCP ToolExecutionCompleted evidence and before terminal task recording, then verifying restart/recovery behavior.
classifications.next_action: Use the closed RRP-7.2 platform/deadline/durability evidence while continuing remaining release blockers: protocol-event-canonization, runtime-release-guard-ci, and owner license/publish decisions.

classifications.title: Hosted scheduler, daemon, job queue, and worker fleet

classifications.title: Forge and notification adapters
evidence: GitHub/GitLab Apps, PR create/update/merge workflows, Slack/Teams/email, SIEM, OTel, and customer-system adapters are external adapter readiness, not Runtime release blockers.
classifications.next_action: Track as adapter product work only after Runtime release closure.

classifications.title: Enterprise, Assurance, and commercial solution readiness
evidence: Tenant management, SSO/RBAC server, customer admin UI, billing, certified stack, continuity assurance, and broad BDK/Enterprise/Assurance surfaces are outside this Runtime-owned campaign.
classifications.next_action: Do not use these items to block Brownie Runtime release.
